tools.name: get_color_quiz
tools.description: Returns the 7 official personal color analysis questions with valid option IDs so the assistant can interview the user before calling run_color_analysis.

tools.name: run_color_analysis
tools.description: Classifies the user's preliminary season among the 12 seasons from their 7 quiz answers and returns a pre-filled calibration URL so they only need to take 1 white-paper photo on their phone.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: Lists all 12 expanded color seasons with family, summary, best jewelry metal, and guide URLs. Optionally filter by family.

tools.name: get_season_details
tools.description: Returns the 10-color hex palette, 4 colors to avoid near the face, jewelry metal, and lip/blush/eye/hair/outfit tips for any of the 12 seasons.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Queries GlowMap's active makeup catalog (currently curated for Brazil / Mercado Livre) filtered by season, category, skin depth, and undertone.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches GlowMap's educational guides on color analysis, undertones, contrast, makeup, and the 12 seasons.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown content of any GlowMap guide by slug or path (e.g., 'skin-undertone-test', '/seasons/warm-autumn', 'subtom-de-pele').

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_color_quiz" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns the 7 official personal color analysis questions with valid option IDs so the assistant can interview the user before calling run_color_analysis.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
